description: The bar chart illustrates the performance scores of three different models—SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B—across four distinct tasks: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics. The vertical axis represents the score, ranging from 35 to 80, while the horizontal axis lists the tasks. For each task, three bars are displayed, with SRPO-7B represented by a dark blue bar, GRPO-7B by a medium blue bar, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B by a light blue bar. In MathVista, SRPO-7B achieves the highest score of 75.8, followed by GRPO-7B at 72.3, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B at 68.2. In MathVerse, SRPO-7B scores 55.8, GRPO-7B scores 52.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 46.3. For MMMU-Pro, SRPO-7B scores 42.3, GRPO-7B scores 39.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 36.9. In Physics, SRPO-7B achieves a score of 60.6, GRPO-7B scores 53.5, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 45.4. Across all tasks, SRPO-7B consistently outperforms the other two models, with the largest performance gap observed in MathVista.
